caption:
Can someone explain why 'sign up in 2 minutes' becomes 'cancel by calling during business hours'? 😤

Subscriptions are easy to start and weirdly hard to quit.
And we all pay for at least one we forgot about.

What's the sneakiest subscription you've found on your statement?
first_comment: Be honest: how many subscriptions are you paying for right now? 👇
